overview: A single Go backend service exposes a REST todo management API, extended with a PATCH endpoint to mark individual todos as completed. The service uses in-memory persistence with mutex-guarded concurrency control, bearer-token authentication, and returns consistent JSON responses.
requirements: Expose PATCH /todos/{id} to update completion status
Default to marking completed; optionally accept {"completed": bool} body
Record completed_at timestamp on transition to completed
Return 200 with full updated todo on success
Return 404 for missing todo, 400 for malformed input, 405 for other methods, 401 unauthenticated, 403 unauthorized
Operation must be idempotent and atomic
Require bearer-token authentication consistent with other endpoints
Include automated tests for all cases

components.name: todo-api
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Todo API
  version: 1.1.0
servers:
  - url: /
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
  /todos:
    get:
      summary: List todos
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo'
    post:
      summary: Create todo
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [title]
              properties:
                title: { type: string }
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
  /todos/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get todo
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
    patch:
      summary: Mark todo completion status
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                completed: { type: boolean, default: true }
              additionalProperties: false
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated todo
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Todo' }
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
        '405': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
    delete:
      summary: Delete todo
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '204': { description: Deleted }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Error' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
  responses:
    Error:
      description: Error response
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error' }
  schemas:
    Todo:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        owner: { type: string }
        completed: { type: boolean }
        completed_at: { type: string, format: date-time, nullable: true }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Error:
      type: object
      properties:
        code: { type: string }
        message: { type: string }
components.componentAgentInstructions:
Build a Go 1.22+ HTTP service using net/http on port 9090. Implement an in-memory todo store protected by sync.RWMutex with map[string]*Todo. Todo fields: ID (UUID string), Title, Owner, Completed bool, CompletedAt *time.Time, CreatedAt time.Time.

Routes:
- GET /health -> 200 {"status":"ok"}
- GET /todos (auth) -> list todos owned by authenticated user
- POST /todos (auth) -> create todo, 201
- GET /todos/{id} (auth)
- PATCH /todos/{id} (auth) -> parse optional JSON body {"completed": bool} with DisallowUnknownFields; if body empty/missing, default completed=true. Validate id is non-empty (return 400 if malformed). Look up todo (404 if missing). Verify owner matches auth subject (403 otherwise). Under write lock, set Completed = requested value; if transitioning to completed, set CompletedAt = now; if setting to false, set CompletedAt = nil. Return 200 with full updated Todo JSON. Idempotent.
- DELETE /todos/{id} (auth)
- Any other method on /todos/{id} -> 405 with Allow header.

Auth middleware: require Authorization: Bearer <token>. Decode token as user id (simple static validation acceptable for demo; reject empty -> 401). Put subject in request context.

Errors: always respond with JSON {"code":"...","message":"..."}; never leak internals. Log errors with context via log package.

Seed a couple of sample todos at startup. Provide Dockerfile (multi-stage, distroless/static). Include unit tests (httptest) covering: successful patch, default-to-true, explicit false, 404, 401, 403 for other owners, 400 malformed body / unknown fields, 405 on PUT, and idempotency (two successive PATCHes yield same completed_at unchanged after the first).
